RGP provides on-demand talent, consulting, and outsourced services, and is hiring a NetSuite Developer for a client. The role supports ERP migrations, develops and maintains NetSuite customizations and financial-system integrations, and helps ensure the stability and scalability of the financial systems platform. The developer will collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Technology stakeholders, and implementation partners on reporting, consolidation, testing, support, and IPO-readiness initiatives.
Commercial
Work & Life Balance
Hiring Manager
Sam D.
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and deploy SuiteScript 2.x customizations, including suitelets, user event scripts, scheduled scripts, map/reduce scripts, RESTlets, and workflow action scripts, to support financial workflows and automation
Configure and maintain NetSuite environments across multiple subsidiaries, including custom records, saved searches, workflows, roles, and permissions
Support ERP migration projects (D365 to NetSuite, NetSuite to NetSuite) by performing data loading, validation, entity setup, and cutover activities
Build and maintain integrations between NetSuite and adjacent financial systems, including our homegrown Accounting Gateway (ACG), FloQast, Anaplan, BigQuery/Airflow, Ignite, and Adaptive, plus SFTP data feeds, using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware patterns
Write and troubleshoot SQL-based queries and saved searches to support reporting, reconciliation, and data validation needs
Address the growing backlog of Financial Systems support tickets, resolving configuration issues, report requests, and user access questions to reduce dependency on senior technical resources
Build and execute test plans for releases across NetSuite and, as scope expands, Anaplan, Floqast, and ZipHQ
Document technical designs, configurations, and runbooks to reduce single-person dependency on senior team members and support institutional knowledge retention
Collaborate with third-party implementation partners (LIDD) to execute project deliverables and ensure quality of configuration and development work
Contribute to IPO readiness efforts by supporting chart of accounts standardization, bank reconciliation automation, fixed asset module configuration, and financial reporting infrastructure
Assist in developing a repeatable playbook for integrating future acquisitions into the NetSuite platform

Required
1–3 years of hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including configuration and administration
Working knowledge of JavaScript and SuiteScript (1.0 and/or 2.x), including user event scripts, suitelets, scheduled scripts, RESTlets, and workflow action scripts, or demonstrated ability to learn quickly with mentorship
Foundational understanding of object-oriented programming concepts and NetSuite's underlying data model, including best practices for querying and reporting
Experience with NetSuite data migration (CSV imports, data validation, entity setup)
Familiarity with NetSuite financial modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Bank Reconciliation
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Ability to work cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, and Technology stakeholders, and to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Preferred
Experience working in a multi-entity or multi-subsidiary NetSuite environment preferred
Exposure to system integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, middleware) and data formats (SQL, XML, JSON) is a plus
NetSuite certifications (e.g., SuiteFoundation, SuiteCloud Developer) are a plus but not required
